old_caption:
The video captures a young woman in a dance studio, engaging in a choreographed routine. She is dressed in a denim vest over a black top, paired with a dark pleated skirt and knee-high black boots. Her long hair is tied back in a ponytail. The setting is a well-lit studio with white walls and a large mirror covering one wall, reflecting her movements. The floor is light-colored, and the ceiling features recessed lighting fixtures.

Initially, she stands facing the mirror, then begins to move, stepping side to side and extending her arms gracefully. Her movements are fluid and rhythmic, suggesting a rehearsed dance sequence. As she dances, she maintains a confident posture, occasionally looking at herself in the mirror to ensure proper form. The environment remains static throughout the video, focusing solely on her performance without any additional elements or distractions. The video emphasizes her dance routine, highlighting her skill and the elegance of her movements.

caption:
The video captures a white dance studio with a light floor, dark ceiling spotlights, an air-conditioning unit, a sheer curtain, and a mirror wall. A woman with a long dark ponytail, denim sleeveless top, dark pleated skirt, and black thigh-high heeled boots stands left of center, facing the glass. Her frontal reflection appears clearly in the large mirror. One boot is lifted behind her, knee bent, while one arm extends straight toward the mirror. The lifted foot lowers as she shifts her weight.

The free arm draws in with a bent elbow, hand gesturing near the chest. It later opens outward to the side as her stance widens. Her feet move through an offset, crossed position and then settle into a wider stance. In the visible later movement, one arm rises bent near her face while the other bends across her torso. The mirror reproduces these changes as a frontal image, with small adjustments continuing throughout.
